name: Cutout — subject on transparent background (U²-Net)
description: Cuts the main subject out of a photo and leaves a transparent background. U²-Net runs on the host CPU through ONNX Runtime, so no OpenCV and no custom nodes touch the ROCm container, and the alpha channel comes back lossless in a PNG. Ready for compositing, thumbnails or a ControlNet reference.

models.purpose: U²-Net salient-object matte, ONNX Runtime CPU

notes: Preprocessing mirrors rembg's reference U2netSession — squash-resize to 320x320, /255, ImageNet mean/std — and the matte is min-max normalised and resized back with LANCZOS, so edges stay soft instead of stair-stepped. Single subject only: U²-Net picks one salient object. The PNG is also copied into ComfyUI's input folder so it can be fed straight into a ControlNet or an image-to-image graph.
